analysis_source: video frames only; no audio analysis
primary_method: same black rim mark at opposite reversals; gaussian dark-profile centers with local quadratic endpoint interpolation; rim ellipse correction
amplitude_definition: half total travel between opposite reversals; not independently measured directional amplitude about a known rest position
rotation_count: 360 degrees plus observed black-mark endpoint-angle difference
limitations: marker profile changes with illumination and visibility
arm-edge cross-check differs by approximately 1 to 3 degrees
blue dot not used for precision measurement
